fusions.name: Run to Ground
fusions.desc: Strikes an enemy at or below 30% health up to 7 tiles away, dealing 26 damage, up to 1.3 times that at full reach.

fusions.name: Flushing Beat
fusions.desc: Beats a cone of wings 4 tiles ahead of you, dealing 12 damage to everything in it, with a 50% chance per hit to leave them [Marked] for 8 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Closing Ring
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 20% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Wounded Prey Draws Them
fusions.desc: You deal 12% more damage to enemies below half health.
